faq.q: What does an AI product photo generator make?
faq.a: A listing image, a room scene, a close-up of one detail, or a square ad. You start from one clear photo or a short description. You review the file before you publish.

faq.q: How do I make the photo from one product picture?
faq.a: Upload a product photo or describe the scene, choose the style, then make a square image. You see how many credits it will use before you start.

faq.q: Is there a free AI product photo generator plan?
faq.a: No. There is no free plan. Each image uses 24 credits. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Are the photos usable on a product page?
faq.a: Yes, for a listing image, a room scene, and an ad image. Check each result against the product you ship so the color, shape, and details still match.

faq.q: Can I make a white background and a room scene?
faq.a: Yes. A clean listing and a room scene are separate photos, and each one uses 24 credits. Check the product in both before you publish.

faq.q: Do these photos replace a studio shoot?
faq.a: They replace the studio booking for a new scene. You still compare the file with the product you ship. Add prices in your own editor after download.

faq.q: Can I use the downloads on my store?
faq.a: Downloads have no watermark. You can use them on your store and in ads, under our terms. You still need the rights to the photo you upload. Our [AI product photography guide](page:blog-ai-product-photography-guide) explains that check.

faq.q: Can I add a price or a logo on the photo?
faq.a: Add prices, sale offers, and logo text in your editor after download. Words the tool writes on the photo can be wrong. See [Shopify product photos](page:plat-shopify) for where those files go.

faq.q: Where are the AI product photo templates?
faq.a: Browse [product ad templates](page:templates) for plain product photos, lifestyle scenes, and ad layouts. Then upload your product photo here and describe the scene.

faq.q: Can I make photos in bulk or connect my store through an API?
faq.a: Yes. Upload several photos to make scenes in one batch, or send photos from your store software through the API. Each photo still uses 24 credits, shown before you start.

faq.q: Can I turn the photo into a video with a voiceover?
faq.a: Yes. Turn that photo into a product video. Then add a spoken voice, on-screen captions, or a song from the music library. A 6-second clip uses 24 credits. A 10-second clip uses 40, a 15-second clip uses 60, and a 30-second clip uses 120. [Image to video](page:image-to-video) is that next step.
